=SUMIFS($AC$9:$AC$250,$AA$9:$AA$250,"Beban klaim penjaminan kredit bruto",$AB$9:$AB$250,"*Penjaminan konsumtif*")+SUMIFS($AC$9:$AC$250,$AA$9:$AA$250,"Penerimaan klaim penjaminan ulang",$AB$9:$AB$250,"*Penjaminan konsumtif*")

=-(SUMIFS($AC$9:$AC$250,$AA$9:$AA$250,"Hak subrogasi penjaminan kredit - bruto",$AB$9:$AB$250,"*Penjaminan konsumtif*"))+SUMIFS($AC$9:$AC$250,$AA$9:$AA$250,"Beban penagihan subrogasi",$AB$9:$AB$250,"*Penjaminan konsumtif*")
